title: Long-term kernel_main checklist
summary: Track the path from the current sentinel-and-shutdown kernel_main to the design-doc target: CoreInit, trap shell, reactor/scheduler, VM, subsystem init, and first userspace.

write_sets.notes: Shared roadmap only. Individual implementation slices claim disjoint write sets through their worktree records before parallel work.

steps.title: Keep the current H3 kernel_main sentinel baseline green
steps.notes:
Current kernel_main reaches P::init_early, tx_substrate::init::

(), P::init_later, P::install_kernel_trap_vector, prints txkernel:qemu-riscv64-virt:boot:ok, then powers off. Preserve this while replacing the tail with runtime init. Evidence: baseline maintained through subsequent slices; see docs/progress/worktrees/2026-04-29-coreinit-spine.json.

steps.title: Replace sentinel tail with an explicit CoreInit spine
steps.notes:
Complete in docs/progress/worktrees/2026-04-29-coreinit-spine.json. tx_kernel::kernel_main now delegates to init::CoreInit

::boot, which encodes the current H3 order directly while preserving the reactor task and boot sentinels. H4 slots for post-substrate hooks, VFS/device ordering, scheduler/process/userspace init remain explicit deferred placeholders. Evidence: docs/progress/worktrees/2026-04-29-coreinit-spine.json; CoreInit smoke later upgraded to run_until_idle_with_clock under docs/progress/plans/2026-04-30-reactor-third-wave-dispatch.json (parallel-kernel-coreinit-hal-clock) and init_process_subsystem now runs in init_substrate_if_ready (commit b50a472 boot wiring; decision 2026-05-05-boot-wiring.md).

steps.title: Bring up zone, epoch, index, mutation, and bus foundations before semantic subsystems
steps.notes: Substrate ships epoch::guard / retire_raw, zone Cap/PayloadCap/Weak/IdentRef mechanics, persistent index mutation (RecipeIndex AtomicPtr+writer mutex), and RawQueue/RawPort/RawTrace bus carriers with reactor-owned wakers. Bus wire hardening landed under the third-wave dispatch. Evidence: docs/progress/plans/2026-04-30-reactor-parallel-shards.json (parallel-wait-bus, complete) + docs/progress/plans/2026-04-30-reactor-third-wave-dispatch.json (parallel-substrate-bus-wire-hardening, complete) + docs/progress/plans/2026-05-04-vm-pagebacked-v1-completion.json persistent-epoch-recipes step which exposes tx_substrate::epoch::retire_raw publicly. Tests: cargo test -p tx-substrate (50 tests) and cargo test -p tx-reactor passing under each plan's verification gate.

steps.title: Replace the panic-only vector with the full trap shell and KernelTrapSink
steps.notes: Implement RawTrapFrame, TrapFrameView, TrapFrameMut, classify-from-frame, user and kernel vector installation, return_to_userspace, and direct named KernelTrapSink methods for page fault, syscall, timer, external IRQ, IPI, and sync fault. Keep trap dispatch out of linkme. Trio Phase 1 (commit f2d84b7) replaced the on_syscall/on_page_fault Terminate stubs with a UserspaceRunSlot handoff via the new trap_handoff module: SyscallRequest/PageFaultInfo translators, hand_off_syscall/hand_off_user_pf, current_thread_payload per-hart slot. Pre-ELF Phase 2 (commit abc9fb8) added TrapIf::enter_userspace_with_context as the portable HAL entry hook (default-panic; RV64 board override at boards/tx-hal-riscv64-qemu-virt/src/trap.rs builds Rv64TrapFrame from UserTrapContext via existing restore_user_context+return_to_userspace). Pre-ELF Phase 5 (commit 3cb95d6) added IRQ dispatch table walked at boot via the new explicit register_irq_handler / install_irq_handlers boot step (no linkme — Open Q #4). Plan B for syscall-return writeback is locked in (the trap shell never writes the trap frame; userspace-entry shim drains pending_syscall_return and writes a0 against a fresh frame). Still pending: RawTrapFrame as a portable HAL surface, TrapFrameMut writeback (Plan B is implemented but the legacy direct-write path is not exposed), kernel vector installation, the named KernelTrapSink methods for timer/IPI/sync, and KERNEL_FIXUP_TABLE-style kernel-mode fault recovery.

steps.title: Install user-access and kernel-mode fault recovery
steps.notes: UserAccessIf copyin/copyout exists and is used by page_backed::step_read_to_user / step_write_from_user (PageBacked v1 user-buffer-byte-copy slice). The KERNEL_FIXUP_TABLE kernel-mode-fault recovery path is still pending and depends on the full trap shell to install fixups before kernel-mode dereferences run.

steps.title: Publish per-hart state and explicit SMP gates
steps.notes: Define per-hart kernel stack/scratch/TLS state, current task pointer access, AP parked/online states, and a clear single-hart gate for features that do not yet have remote coordination. AP startup may stay disabled until remote shootdown and scheduler handoff land.

steps.title: Implement reactor task table, wait-adapt, wakers, idle, and MVP scheduler
steps.notes: Three reactor dispatch plans landed the task table, wait/bus subscription, timer queue, scheduler shell, AST poll-boundary consumption, cooperative yield, userspace-run shell, and per-hart loop API. Evidence: docs/progress/plans/2026-04-30-reactor-parallel-shards.json (complete; 65 reactor tests, ci green) + docs/progress/plans/2026-04-30-reactor-third-wave-dispatch.json (complete; 71 reactor tests, ci green) + docs/progress/plans/2026-05-01-reactor-runtime-dispatch.json (complete; userspace-run + per-hart loop merged, ci green). Per-hart loop and userspace-run remain reactor-local shells; trap-side return_to_userspace and AST signal policy are owned by trap-shell-and-kernel-sink and process-and-thread-runtime-core.

steps.title: Implement VM AddressSpace, recipes, RangeLock, and pmap materialization
steps.notes: AddressSpace ships with persistent (AtomicPtr+writer-mutex, EBR-retired) RecipeIndex per VM_v1_2 §1.2, ExclusiveWriter/SharedReader RangeLock acquire_step/acquire_pair_step, pmap materialization through PmapIf, fault_script_async, map/unmap/protect/remap/brk async scripts, fork_aspace + exec_aspace, mincore/madvise/msync, and a wait_carrier-backed RangeLock release channel. Trap page-fault dispatch and Process ownership of Cap<AddressSpace> remain owned by downstream steps. Evidence: docs/progress/plans/2026-05-04-vm-pagebacked-v1-completion.json (complete) + docs/progress/decisions/2026-05-04-vm-pagebacked-v1-plan-closure.md + commits cb35a62 (rename scripts to VM_v1_2 spec names), 63e72fc (reconcile VM_v1_2 with implementation surface), 83a3903 (MADV_DONTNEED + MADV_FREE), b9c7c38 (RangeLock acquire_step canonical surface).

steps.title: Complete multi-page, superpage, ASID/global, and remote shootdown accounting
steps.notes: Generalize current page-sized local batches to multi-frame runs, superpage accounting, ASID-scoped and global invalidations, and remote-hart acknowledgment. Until this lands, keep user/VM runtime behind a single-hart gate or explicit no-remote-shootdown mode.

steps.title: Implement PageContainer, RNodeBacking, materialize_page, and reclaim policy hooks
steps.notes: PageContainer, FsPageBacking/RNodeBacking, materialize_page, install_shared_page + cow_replace_into_private (reflink/CoW scaffold), step_read/step_write/step_read_to_user/step_write_from_user, step_truncate (with byte-accurate partial-EOF zero), step_fallocate, step_fsync, and step_copy_file_range all shipped under PAGE_BACKED_v1. PAGE_BACKED §8 reclaim policy and §12 writeback scheduling hooks remain explicitly deferred by the design docs. Evidence: docs/progress/plans/2026-05-04-vm-pagebacked-v1-completion.json (complete) + docs/progress/decisions/2026-05-04-vm-pagebacked-v1-plan-closure.md. 43 page_backed tests + 60 vm tests pass under that plan's verification gate.

steps.title: Implement Process, ThreadIdentity/ThreadPayload, and thread_future skeleton
steps.notes:
Process / ProcessGroup / Session / Thread topology, signal post-and-observe, default-terminate route via step_exit_group_with_signal, cred + kill permission check, cwd/chdir/getcwd VFS seam, and INIT_PROCESS bootstrap have all landed (commits 3652bd1, c982b81, 51d0b2a, c2bce56, 362b22a, 1f09e2a, 531c783; decisions 2026-05-05-process-topology-day1.md, signal-day1.md, cred-day1.md, ast-dispatch.md, step-exit-group-with-signal.md, cwd-vfs-integration.md). Trio Phase 1 (commit f2d84b7) added ThreadPayload's saved-user-trap-frame storage and signal-state slots (userspace_slot, active_request, saved_user_context, pending_syscall_return) plus the per-hart current_thread_payload registry. Phase 2a (abefad4) added the stub fd table on ProcessPayload with step_fork cloning. Phase 2b (119602b) added brk_base/current_brk on ProcessPayload and bootstrap_init_process seeding. Pre-ELF Phase 2 (commit abc9fb8) shipped the production thread_future skeleton: pub async fn run_thread

(payload) loops dispatch -> AST -> entry-shim -> divergent enter_userspace_with_context; pub struct PerHartSlotted stages the per-hart slot around Future::poll; pub fn prepare_userspace_entry_payload(payload) -> UserTrapContext drains pending_syscall_return into a0 (Plan B); pub fn ThreadIdentity::payload_cap() (Phase 7 promotion from payload_cap_for_test). Pre-ELF Phase 7 (commit 69a3efd) restructured run_thread's two-request lifecycle (resolution + entry) so the AST checkpoint subject lives across the divergent call. Step delivered. Remaining for downstream: real per-task AST plumbing so checkpoint_userspace_entry (not _batch with empty AstBatch::default()) can wire signal-handler frames; this is signal-attachments / sigreturn territory.

steps.title: Add syscall dispatch, page-fault dispatch, and AST return-to-user loop
steps.notes: Implement fixed syscall table dispatch, VM page-fault materializer dispatch, error/return-value writes through TrapFrameMut, and Site B AST handling before user re-entry. Timer preemption should not advance thread_future; interesting traps do. Trio Phase 2a (commit abefad4) and Phase 2b (commit 119602b) populated tx-shims with linux_syscall::dispatch covering 8 entries: NR_WRITE, NR_READ, NR_EXIT, NR_EXIT_GROUP, NR_GETPID, NR_BRK, NR_RT_SIGPROCMASK, NR_RT_SIGACTION. Each entry calls existing step_* functions; partial-success Linux semantics for write/read; brk-never-returns-negative semantics; rt_sigaction decodes the 32-byte modern struct (RV64 has no legacy sigaction). Trio Phase 6 (commit 6828b00) end-to-end fake-driver smoke verified the dispatch path through OPOST and zombie transition. Pre-ELF Phase 3 (commit b49b302) added VM page-fault async dispatch in the thread future: aspace.fault_script(VmFault).await with Ok loops back through the userspace-entry checkpoint and Err routes default-action SIGSEGV via step_exit_group_with_signal (txdoc:VM-5-1-FAULT-HANDLER + SIGNAL_v1 §15.1). Pre-ELF Phase 5 (commit 3cb95d6) added the blocking read carrier path: sys_read awaits on tx_subsystems::wait_carrier::wait_on_token, woken by the UART RX IRQ handler -> tty::execution::step_ingest -> tty.input_readable.fire(TTY_READABLE). Pre-ELF Phase 2 (commit abc9fb8) added Plan B writeback discipline (TrapIf::enter_userspace_with_context is the only site that writes a0; trap shell never writes the trap frame). Pre-ELF Phase 7 (commit 69a3efd) end-to-end production smoke (no synthesised driver) exercises the full chain: PerHartSlotted -> run_thread -> dispatch -> walker -> tty -> ConsoleIf, asserts merged regs[10]==dispatcher's encoded return. Step delivered. Remaining for downstream: real per-task AST plumbing (signal-handler frame setup beyond EnterUserspace). Empty-batch AstBatch::default() shortcut is correct for this slice because only EnterUserspace is valid; signal attachments / sigreturn is the next piece.

steps.title: Initialize VFS, tier-1/tier-2 devices, IRQ dispatch, devfs, and console/TTY
steps.notes:
VFS spec-reconciliation Phases 2-4 collapsed VFS/VM/TTY/page_backed into tx-subsystems and the canonical VFS surface (commits d0b2ab6, 1b91e5d; decision 2026-05-04-vfs-spec-reconciliation-phase-2-3-4.md). TTY now publishes typed Cap/Cap and a deliver_tty_dispatch signal bridge (commits 4b68570, a50320c). Trio Phase 3a (commit 91f2175) populated tx-fs::devfs with a read-only FsOps backend that resolves /dev/console through the existing TTY alias registry (StructBacked { Tty }) and exposes open_console_for_init() for fd preopen. Phase 3b (commit ffc098c) populated tx-fs::tmpfs with a full FsOps + FsPageBacking backend over PageContainerKind::Anon { Reclaimable } and added the 5-step boot wiring in init.rs (register_console_hardware -> mount_rootfs_tmpfs -> mount_devfs_at_dev -> register_devfs_console_alias -> bind_init_cwd_and_root). ROOT_MOUNT, DEV_MOUNT, CONSOLE_TTY globals are populated; init.fd(0/1/2) are preopened to /dev/console. Pre-ELF Phase 4 (commit 04edaa6) shipped the VFS walker (step_walk + step_open with SYMLOOP_MAX=40 hop ELOOP). Pre-ELF Phase 6 (commit e757bc0) added MountId/DevId allocators, wired mount::register_mount(&rootfs_payload, dev_object_id, dev_mount) into mount_devfs_at_dev, and added FsOps::materialise_rnode override on devfs so the walker resolves /dev/console end-to-end (boot smoke boot_smoke_walker_resolves_dev_console_after_mount_registration). Pre-ELF Phase 5 (commit 3cb95d6) added the IRQ dispatch table walked at boot via crates/tx-kernel/src/irq.rs::install_irq_handlers, registers UART RX handler under

::UART_IRQ, drains via ConsoleIf::read_bytes, calls tty::execution::step_ingest. Boot trace: :process:init:ok -> :tty:console:ok -> :irq:install:ok -> :mount:rootfs:tmpfs:ok -> :mount:devfs:ok -> :devfs:console:alias:ok -> :init:cwd:ok -> :boot:ok. Step delivered.

steps.title: Build exec loader and detached AddressSpace construction
steps.notes: AddressSpace::exec_aspace teardown landed under VM/PageBacked v1 (exec-aspace step), but the exec loader itself is unbuilt: crates/tx-scripts/src/lib.rs is still an 8-line stub. Implement static-ELF image planning, targeted file reads, detached AddressSpace construction, stack/auxv population, process Frame vm replacement at the point of no return, and ThreadRuntime trap-context install. Keep fallible work before exec's PoNR.

steps.title: Replace kernel_main shutdown with init process spawn and first return_to_userspace
steps.notes:
Boot wiring already calls bootstrap_init_process and emits a process:init:ok sentinel (commit b50a472, decision 2026-05-05-boot-wiring.md). Pre-ELF Phase 7 (commit 69a3efd) replaced kernel_main's shutdown path with run_userspace_reactor_loop: builds PerHartSlotted::::new(payload, run_thread::

(thread, payload)), submits via BOOT_REACTOR.with(|r| r.submit_task(...)), drives the BSP hart-loop via step_boot_reactor_once until init.is_zombie(), then emits :userspace:exited:N (where N is ExitStatus::wait_status_word()) before system_off. :boot:ok still emits unchanged from boot_sentinel. Production loop is wired and ready; on RV64 boards with no userspace binary loaded yet the loop parks in WFI. Remaining for this step: load a real ELF into init's address space and seed payload.saved_user_context with the binary's entry point + sp — that is exec-loader-and-detached-aspace's responsibility (next slice). Once the loader lands, the loop will pick up the binary on the first enter_userspace_with_context call.

steps.title: Enable AP runtime, cross-hart wakeups, IPIs, and remote shootdown
steps.notes: Bring secondary harts online after substrate and before multi-hart scheduling. Install trap vectors on APs, initialize per-hart reactor/scheduler state, support SmpIf IPIs for wake/reschedule/shootdown, and remove the single-hart runtime gate.

steps.title: Add long-running boot tests for shell, BusyBox, and OSComp images
steps.notes: Keep smoke boot separate from runtime boot. Add sentinels for first init entry, first syscall roundtrip, shell prompt, BusyBox command, and OSComp suite readiness as the syscall/VFS/device surface grows.

verification.notes: Re-run on 2026-05-06 after pre-ELF wave 1-5 landed in 7 phase commits on feat/pre-elf-runtime (04edaa6 wave 1 minors+walker; e757bc0 wave 2 id allocators+register_mount; abc9fb8 wave 3 task wrapper+entry shim+HAL hook; b49b302 wave 4 page-fault async; 3cb95d6 wave 4 IRQ dispatch+UART RX; 69a3efd wave 5 production smoke+kernel_main reactor loop). Three long-term steps promoted to complete: process-and-thread-runtime-core, syscall-dispatch-and-ast-loop, vfs-device-and-tty-init. 24+ ok.
Use after implementation slices, not required for pure checklist creation.

risks: The current code is substrate-heavy but has no zone/epoch/bus/reactor implementation yet; those are prerequisites for most upper subsystems.
A full trap shell without a VM fault path can only panic or terminate; user execution should stay gated until VM and thread runtime exist.
Remote shootdown and AP scheduling can be deferred for single-hart runtime, but the gate must be explicit to avoid false SMP safety.
Design docs reference many future subsystems; individual implementation slices should refresh readiness before coding from them.
blockers: Pre-ELF Phase 2 (commit abc9fb8) added TrapIf::enter_userspace_with_context as the portable HAL entry hook; RawTrapFrame as a portable HAL surface and TrapFrameMut direct-write are still not exposed at the trait level (they live as RV64 board internals).

Pre-ELF Phase 2 shipped the production thread_future skeleton (run_thread + PerHartSlotted + prepare_userspace_entry_payload) and Phase 7 wired kernel_main into the production reactor loop; with no ELF loader, the loop parks in WFI on real boards.

tx-shims linux_syscall::dispatch covers 8 entries (trio Phase 2a/2b); page-fault async dispatch landed in pre-ELF Phase 3; IRQ-driven blocking read landed in pre-ELF Phase 5. Real per-task AST plumbing (signal-handler frame setup beyond EnterUserspace) is the remaining piece; uses empty-batch AstBatch::default() shortcut today.
tx-scripts (exec loader) is still an empty stub — this is the immediate next slice that unlocks first userspace.
tmpfs + devfs mounted at boot via the trio + walker via pre-ELF Phase 4 + register_mount + materialise_rnode wire-up via pre-ELF Phase 6; /dev/console resolves end-to-end through the walker now.
